summary: Converting xn--55555577 to ASCII overflows the Punycode decoder's accumulator, causing a panic when overflow checks are enabled. Internal callers bypass the existing overflow guard. The fix uses checked_add to return an error instead. The fix-added test in idna/tests/unit.rs, in the idna package's unit test target, exercises this input. The reversal restores only the unchecked addition; both regions occur exactly once in their respective Git objects. No tests were executed.
